messages.subject: Project Ironvale - instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed acquisition of Stradbrook Thermal (heat-exchanger maker in Northampton). We're calling it Project Ironvale. Could you get an NDA and engagement terms over to us this week? Target is c.£42.5m EV.

Margaret

messages.subject: RE: Project Ironvale - instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Margaret,

Delighted to act. I attach a mutual NDA for signature with Stradbrook, and our engagement letter setting out scope and fees (estimate £185k-£225k plus VAT). James Osei will run the day-to-day with Elena Marchetti.

Please sign and return the engagement letter at your convenience and we'll get the AML pack to Donna.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
